tenantAuth.description: Your store's **publishable key**, sent as `Authorization: Bearer pk_…`. A publishable key is public by design: it is printed in page source and in static sites, so it reaches storefront endpoints only. Create one under Settings > API keys.

accountAuth.description: A signed-in customer's own token, returned by the `Login` endpoint and sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on `/account` routes. On the storefront routes outside `/account` the `Authorization` header carries the store's key instead, so a customer's token travels there in its own `marzipan-customer-auth` header.

secretAuth.description: A **secret key**, sent as `Authorization: Bearer sk_…`. A secret key reaches the management endpoints as well as the storefront ones, so it belongs on a server and must never appear in a browser. It is shown once when you create it and stored hashed after that. A publishable key presented to a management endpoint is answered with a 401 rather than a 403, because the kind of key is wrong rather than its permissions.

On a plan with dated shipments the subscription resumes on the next shipment that is not skipped; otherwise the billing date is walked forward a billing interval at a time until it is no longer in the past.

`actions.canUndoSkip` on the subscription says whether this call will succeed.
